dedupe_keys.name: osterreichischer kataster austrian cadastre web application of the bev

description: The Österreichischer Kataster web application of the Federal Office of Metrology and Surveying (BEV) shows Austria's cadastre, the official register of land parcels and their boundaries, on a national map. The application read on 2026-09-28 has English and German interfaces with a guide, statistics, a video, search, a download function and a layer panel, and asks users to accept cookies and local storage before use. Coverage is national, for all cadastral parcels. Access is free in the browser; the licence of the downloadable cadastral data is not stated in the application read. Caveats: the layer list and download formats were not visible before accepting the cookie prompt in the headless session, and the cadastre gives parcels and land-use categories, not buildings or networks. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure studies in Austria, such as linking flood or landslide zones to parcels and land use. No related Austrian cadastre record is catalogued; the Austrian census building data complement it.
